description: An HR director must resolve a workplace-conduct complaint arising from repeated interruptions and exclusion during design-review meetings between Jules and Kai. The director must determine the case finding and finalize the communication, restorative, and documentation process.

shared_context.S1: Jules submitted a complaint that Kai repeatedly interrupted her and excluded her from design-review discussions.
shared_context.S2: Marisol has authority to determine the documented case finding and the follow-up process.
shared_context.S3: The complaint concerns conduct during recurring design-review meetings attended by several members of the design group.
shared_context.S4: As part of the normal case process, Marisol conducts a check-in with the complainant, respondent, an attendee familiar with the meetings, and HR compliance before finalizing the outcome.

PF1.text: Jules kept a dated log of exactly three meetings in which Kai interrupted her while she was presenting and then redirected the discussion without returning to her proposal; she has not included the log in the formal case file.

PF2.text: Kai has a documented processing accommodation requiring written feedback and a written agenda at least 2 business days before any live corrective discussion; Kai has not yet raised this scheduling need in the complaint process.

PF3.text: Nadia attended a prior repair conversation in which the design manager promised that any future joint discussion between Jules and Kai would include a neutral facilitator; the promise was never added to the case notes.

PF4.text: Trevor confirmed this week that HR policy requires separate intake meetings before any joint restorative meeting in a substantiated interpersonal-conduct case, along with a confidentiality log; this policy check has not yet been attached to the case packet.

acceptance_conditions: The conduct finding must be substantiated.
Exactly three documented observations must support the finding.
Kai must receive written feedback and a written agenda at least 2 business days before any live corrective discussion.
Any joint restorative discussion must use a neutral facilitator.
Separate intake meetings must occur before any joint restorative meeting.
A confidentiality log must be created.
The settlement must include commitments for the written-first communication process, facilitated repair, and confidentiality documentation.

content_checks.C6: any(c['type'] == 'written_first_communication' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'facilitated_repair' for c in commitments) and any(c['type'] == 'confidentiality_documentation' for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids and 'PF1' in revealed

decisive_facts.why: Jules's log changes the documented evidence count from no specified observations to exactly three and supplies the basis for a substantiated finding.
Kai's accommodation changes the communication process to written feedback and agenda materials exactly 2 business days before a live corrective discussion.
The prior manager promise changes the restorative process to a neutral-facilitated repair and requires a corresponding facilitated-repair commitment.
The confirmed HR policy changes the process to require separate intakes before joint repair, creates the confidentiality-log requirement, and requires a documentation commitment.
